role: Climate edge rules in three modes: COOL_WARM turns warm land next to cold into temperate, HEAT_ICE turns icy land next to warm into cold, SPECIAL tags 1 in 13 land cells with a special-biome flag in bits 8..11.
scope_reason: Part of the overworld biome layer stack (GenLayer.initializeAllBiomeGenerators) that decides the biome of every overworld column.

members.name: field_151627_c
members.note: The mode is the layer kind (L_EDGE_*) dispatched in layer_ints.

members.name: getInts
members.note: The mode switch is layer_ints' switch on kind.

members.name: SwitchMode
members.note: javac's synthetic switch map (a static int[] filled by its static initializer, read by a switch on the enum); the class is never instantiated, so its implicit constructor never runs

notes: layers.c builds the stack as a pointer graph of struct layer nodes (p1, p2) in a fixed 64-node array and recurses through it, and each layer mallocs its parent area per call (area()); both are GPU-contract hazards but outside the tick (chunk generation). Status exact rests on test_worldgen comparing the genbiomes and biomes stages against the oracle chunk dumps; the gate was not re-run for this record.
